name: Doors, trapdoors, fence gates, note blocks, bells, copper bulbs and other consumers
deviations: bells, copper bulbs and the other consumers are not modeled
player heads with a note block sound of their own play nothing
note: Doors, trapdoors and fence gates of every kind open and close with the power around them and by hand (iron ones only by power), quietly, with a level-random draw for the sound; note blocks take the instrument of the block below or a head above and play on a rising signal and when used, as block events that draw for the sound
